serving_contract: User JWT validated with Auth and current application session before any privileged file fetch.
An authenticated SECURITY INVOKER metadata RPC intersects all existing Storage RLS policies; no caller-supplied user, role, or workspace authority.
The server fetches bytes only after authorization and rechecks current object identity, version and RLS after fetching; no signed URL is issued.
All success and error responses are private no-store; bytes are attachment/octet-stream with nosniff and no-referrer.
Frontend binds each response to captured user/workspace/epoch and current listed file; discarded responses never create URLs. Blob URLs are revoked after use or branding reset.
A separate restrictive Storage SELECT policy blocks raw byte downloads, rendering and signed URL creation while retaining existing authorized metadata/upload/delete operations.
The four private buckets must be empty before the restrictive cutover so no old cached object remains in scope. This does not recall copies a user already downloaded.
deployment_order: Test local actual-handler, frontend, invoker/RLS intersection and operation cases; preserve pinned dependency lock.
Add metadata RPC with an exact catalog precondition and reviewed atomic catalog rebind, leaving old serving paths working.
Deploy and read back the staging-only Edge broker, then prove genuine owner/foreign/session denials with harmless fixtures.
Prepare and publish a reviewed staging static bundle preserving the current pinned SDK, headers and worker; verify bundle identity.
Only after frontend availability and empty-bucket readback, apply restrictive SELECT policy and reviewed catalog rebind; exercise finite revocation and cleanup cases.
hosted_cases: Personal own/foreign/anonymous and current-session denial; metadata RPC conveys no bytes.
Family active owner/member then same-session removed member; identical warmed broker request denied after removal, owner still allowed.
Business registered document parent scope and archived/removal denial; logo owner/member/removal and subscription owner/staff/foreign boundaries.
Direct authenticated/public bytes, rendering and signing denied for the four buckets after cutover; ordinary upload/delete still work.
Exact fixture, object and session cleanup; original manual Family, Business money rows, roles, inactive membership and expired paid-through preserved.

fixture_bounds.auth_accounts: existing controlled A/B/Admin only; no Auth row creation/reset
fixture_bounds.files: unique harmless 68-byte PNG files; Storage API upload/delete only
fixture_bounds.family: one new isolated public Family fixture; remove member through supported RPC and delete fixture after checks
fixture_bounds.business: only existing isolated audit-batch-x-receipt-d7be160c2026; exact temporary entitlement and supported seats/status/member actions with guarded restoration

rollback: Clean exact attempted fixture objects and sessions first; restore reviewed static artifact and remove only the new restrictive policy/RPC in reverse order with exact catalog guards. Do not silently re-enable unsafe delivery as a successful fix.
acceptance_limits: Local or additive broker passes do not close the original cached access finding. Closure requires actual restrictive cutover and same-session warmed-request revocation acceptance; full X, V, Z and release remain open.
